{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ante Room''' was located within the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It was the original site of [[Lucky's Tavern]]. The Ante Room housed a dance floor accompanied by pre-recorded [[Music/Legends|music]] although occasionally live bands were hosted in its place. The dance floor was surrounded by [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]] that varied the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. The Ante Room also contained [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machines such as [[warp-top]], [[Spatz]], and [[Jubilee Wheel (game)|Jubilee Wheels]].
